top_signals.title: Oil Prices Drop 4% as Traders Dismiss US Sanctions
top_signals.summary: Oil prices fell about 4% to a one-week low on Tuesday as traders shrugged off the latest U.S. sanctions campaign against Iran, viewing economic pressure as posing less risk to oil supplies than a military escalation.Brent crude futures were down $3.83, or 4.2%, to $88.34 a barrel by 11:44 a.m.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Russian Oil Freight Rates Spike On Security Risks, Vessel Availability
top_signals.summary: Freight rates for tanker shipments of Russia's flagship Urals crude from western ports to India, the grade's main market, have surged in August as strong demand for vessels and mounting security risks linked to carrying Russian oil drove up costs…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Russia Strikes Five Vessels in Ports Along Ukrainian Black Sea
top_signals.summary: The Russian Defence Ministry said on Tuesday that its forces had struck three cargo vessels carrying supplies for the Ukrainian military and a tanker at the Black Sea port of Pivdennyi.The ministry also said it had hit another cargo vessel in the nearby port of Odesa, as well as port infrastructure
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Copper Closing In on Record High as Supply Pressures Build Up
top_signals.summary: Copper rose for a fourth day — closing in on a record high — as short-term supplies continued to look tight despite an easing of last week’s severe market squeeze.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
